description: A parsed EU document by CELEX: metadata plus body (articles, recitals, judgment paragraphs, annexes). Large documents return an outline first; then read an article with articleId or parts with include. content: null means no published text — textAvailability says why and may point to the latest consolidated version. Consolidated CELEXes (0…-YYYYMMDD) are labelled: not the authentic text, cite the base act. Cost: 1 credit from the corpus, 4 via the Publications Office, 5 live (every call is charged).

items.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

acceptLanguages.description: Fallback languages to serve when the requested one has no text (e.g. ["fr"] for General Court decisions), or "any".

bypassCorpus.description: Force a fresh upstream read (charged at the live rate). Only when the stored copy is suspected stale.

include.description: Only these parts. "paragraphs" = judgment grounds / text of documents without articles.

language.description: Language of the whole document (default en). Falls back to English, labelled languageFallback, when EUR-Lex lacks it.

offset.description: Continue after a truncated response (value given in its note).

view.description: auto: the body if it fits maxChars, else an outline. full: body up to maxChars, then offset to continue.

name: lex_get_document
title: Fetch an EU document by CELEX
